selected_candidate.name: Integer Transformer Accelerator
selected_candidate.why_selected: ITA is explicitly an RTL accelerator for Transformer Multi-Head Attention with an integer softmax path and test vector generation, matching the current modern-NN gap better than another NVDLA CMAC or generic SGEMM target.
selected_candidate.license_observation: Repository README states software uses Apache-2.0 and hardware uses Solderpad Hardware License 0.51; verify exact files before import.

candidate_sources_consulted.finding: Repository README says it contains RTL code and a test generator for a Multi-Head Attention accelerator.
Paper describes ITA as an attention and softmax accelerator for quantized Transformers.
AttentionLego is attention-related, but its processing-in-memory focus and project shape make it a less conservative first import candidate.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: AttentionLego
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Relevant to self-attention, but less directly aligned with this repo's Verilator RTL seed workflow than ITA's RTL/testbench repository.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: Tiny LeViT Hardware Accelerator
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Contains attention-layer hardware, but is a hobby LeViT accelerator rather than a focused MHA/softmax RTL seed.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: Vortex SGEMM collateral in current tree
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Matrix multiplication workload collateral, not a source-backed attention/QKV/softmax RTL seed.
